user.title: Attic ventilation sensors
user.description: Pick the temperature sensors to average and the QuietCool fan to control. The fan's own temperature is included in the attic average. If the fan has a mode select, point Airbend at it so the fan's built-in thermostat does not fight this controller.

data.manual_mode: Mode to select before taking control
data.circulate_mode: Fan mode when CO2 is high
data.idle_fan_mode: Fan mode when CO2 is normal
data.shutoff_switches: Outlets to turn off during an alarm

behavior.title: When to ventilate
behavior.description: Temperatures use {unit}. Summer starts when the indoor average rises to the comfort line, and winter starts after it falls by the hysteresis. In summer the fan runs when the attic is warmer than the house and warmer than outside by at least the minimum difference.

data.hysteresis_c: Hysteresis before switching back to winter
data.min_delta_c: Attic must be this much warmer than outside
data.safety_max_c: Always ventilate above this attic temperature
data.ice_dam_outdoor_max_c: Ice-dam guard: outdoor at or below
data.ice_dam_attic_min_c: Ice-dam guard: attic at or above
data.ice_dam_enabled: Cool the roof deck when it could melt snow
data.min_on_minutes: Minimum minutes the fan stays on
data.min_off_minutes: Minimum minutes the fan stays off
data.co2_hysteresis: Drop this far below the threshold before stopping

error.threshold_order: Each speed step has to be warmer than the one below it, and the safety limit has to be the hottest.
error.ice_dam_order: The ice-dam attic temperature has to be below the winter buffer limit, or the guard never gets a chance to run.
error.co2_hysteresis: The CO2 drop has to be smaller than the threshold.
